guide.setup: Sit tall with feet braced, knees soft, arms extended, and the chest lifted while holding a neutral-grip attachment.
guide.execution: Pull the handle to the lower ribs by driving the elbows back, then reach forward under control.
guide.cues: Keep the torso quiet. Pull elbows toward the hips. Let shoulders reach at the front.
guide.mistakes: Rocking the torso; shrugging; pulling high to the chest; shortening the reach.
